title: 建設用一輪手押し車
description: 深い開放荷台、一本の車輪、支持脚と長い取っ手を備えた土砂・園芸資材用の一輪車。買物カートやパレット運搬車とは異なる用途の静的モデル。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。
descriptionEn: Open deep-tray single-wheel barrow for loose soil and landscaping material, with folded support legs and long handles. Distinct from basket shopping trolleys and pallet jacks; static visual model with no load rating. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing.
author: Xenoah
uv: Original UV coordinates and split normals retained. Tangents are not exported; calculate them in the receiving application.
descriptionScope: Original model purpose and source-format notes; FBX-specific facts and differences are in CONVERSION.json and CONVERSION_NOTES.md.
